alice.martin: quick q — for the new auto-fallback rollout, should the default be a soft-degrade that surfaces a user hint (eg. "responses may be simplified") or a silent fallback that only shows in telemetry?
ben.choi: lean soft-degrade + hint. product teams can surface UX, and we avoid weird silent behavior that confuses users. :thumbsup:
maya.k: agree but worried about PII/exposure in hint wording. we should standardize allowable hint templates and locale support.
ryan.ops: from ops perspective, silent fallback + strong telemetry is easier to keep SLAs, but then product teams lose visibility. can we do both? minimal user hint + enhanced audit entry?
alice.martin: proposal idea — default = minimal hint + operator-visible audit event. opt-out flag for silent-only. default should be safest for user trust.
ben.choi: that sounds fine. also think we need a console affordance to preview what users will see for each target route. small mock: `Fallback preview: soft ("responses may be simplified") | silent (no UI)`
maya.k: +1 for preview. and please add translation keys, e.g. `fallback.hint.minimal` so i18n folks can review.
ryan.ops: logging needs to include: fallback_reason, active_policy_id, route_id, and sampling_id. also retention policy note — keep these audit records for 90 days by default.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: rollout/fallback-config v0.6 -> staging (initiated by alice.martin) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alice.martin: below is a rough config snippet for discussion — please nitpick

```
policy: auto-fallback
default_mode: soft
hint_key: "fallback.hint.minimal"
audit_level: full
audit_retention_days: 90
sampling: 1/10
```
ben.choi: sampling 1/10 seems high for some high-volume routes — maybe adaptive sampling based on QPS would be better.
maya.k: agree, add `hint_allowlist` and `redaction_rules` so we don't accidentally leak things in the hint.
ryan.ops: also add `telemetry_tags: [policy_id, route_id, region, model_variant]` so SRE can filter quickly.
alice.martin: ok next actions: (1) ben will prototype adaptive sampling heuristic, (2) maya will draft hint templates + i18n keys + redaction rules, (3) ryan will write minimal audit schema and retention plan. i'll make a short console preview mock next.
ben.choi: i'll mock sampling + cost estimate.
maya.k: will ping i18n and privacy for review.
ryan.ops: i'll open an internal schema PR for the audit events.
alice.martin: thanks — let’s aim to have prototypes by EOW. if anyone wants to join pairing, ping me. :wave:
